UNIT_TESTS.TEST: Delete, truncate, corrupt, remove directory, rename, and lock actions apply to fixture-local paths only.
Each resilience spec uses a fresh fixture so corruption does not leak between cases.
Expected exit and output substring checks produce actionable failure reasons.
Index-storage deletion targets the fixture XDG data home, not the developer data directory.

INTEGRATION_TESTS.TEST: Corrupted synapsec.toml returns a graceful config error.
Deleted index storage makes search suggest syn index instead of panicking.
Missing docs directory can be recovered by syn init.
Missing module shard is visible through syn status.

TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Chaos tests never mutate the developer checkout or user config directories.
